outcome: rate of hysterectomy due to placenta accreta
accuracy of prenatal diagnosis of placenta accreta
relationship between placenta previa and hysterectomy
cohort: 92 pregnant women who underwent peripartum hysterectomy due to control of postpartum hemorrhage and placenta accreta syndrome between 2016 and 2020
finding: The most common reason for hysterectomy was placenta accreta, which was often related to placenta previa.
